decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf is an everyday staple close to the core range, so it is cheap to keep and likely still sells to regular customers.
Sweet pastries fit the traditional assortment and need few extra resources, although bakeries rotate pastry varieties more often than breads.
A crusty farmhouse bread matches the heritage, regional-ingredient positioning and is a typical long-running item in a craft bakery.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is presented as a flagship with its own page, which makes it a key seasonal product the firm will keep.
The gold-awarded premium stollen supports the firm's quality image and its Christmas gift sales, so dropping it is unlikely.
